import java.util.Scanner;

public class Solution {
	public static void main(String[] args) {
		Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
		String s = "";
		try {
			s = in.nextLine();
		} catch (Exception e) {
			e.printStackTrace();
		}
		in.close();
		
		System.out.println(compute(s));
	}
	
	public static int compute(String s) {
		int result = 0;
		int length = s.length();
		for (int i = 0; i < length; ) {
			int j = i;
			while (j + 1 < length && s.charAt(j) == s.charAt(j + 1)) {
				j++;
			}
			int groupSize = j - i + 1;
			if (groupSize % 2 == 0) {
				result++;
			}
			i = j + 1;
		}
		return result;
	}
}
